title: senna barronfieldii
intro: Senna barronfieldii, commonly known as Barron's senna, is a plant species belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). The health benefits of Senna barronfieldii include its ability to act as a natural laxative and aid in digestion, due to its high fiber content and anthraquinone glycosides. Therapeutically, Senna barronfieldii is used to treat constipation, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and other gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Senna barronfieldii include sennosides, emodin, and other anthraquinone glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
